IDENT.title: Dynamic distributed decision-making for resilient resource reallocation in disrupted manufacturing systems

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: An RA provides high-level control for a physical resource to perform operations on products; MAS definition cites Wooldridge [14].
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: An RA provides high-level control for a physical resource to perform operations on products.

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: A PA is responsible for fulfilling production requirements for its associated physical part through interactions with other agents, while an RA provides high-level control for its associated resource in the physical layer [16].

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: This work introduces a model-based resource agent (RA) architecture

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: RAs are grouped into two RA classes: transportation and transformation RAs

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: an RA architecture that includes a Knowledge Base, a Communication Manager, and a Decision Manager

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: the beliefs of an agent are comprised of the state, capability, and environment models.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: we propose an RA communication strategy with capability heuristics to avoid the need to communicate and optimize across all of the resources

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: The Communication Manager in this paper includes a request manager and a response manager.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: we use a Repast Symphony (RepastS) platform [44] to model a multi-agent system

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: oc is the number of operations that the resource has performed since the last maintenance event

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Operation count since last maintenance, MTBF, state/capability models, schedule.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: every resource has a historical mean time between failure (MTBF)

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: A resource agent collects data continuously from the associated physical resource through sensors attached to this resource.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: The RA's knowledge of other RAs in the system is captured in the environment model.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: the decision maker updates the capability model if there are any changes to the resource.

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: an RA should understand its own objectives and the complex manufacturing environment.

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: RAd is responsible for choosing a new schedule from the set of possible event sequences Snew.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: A broadcast technique is used for RAs to communicate information [14].

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.value: Number of agent communications (requests, responses, informs)
D_COMMUNICATION__comm_cost_metric.evidence_quote: the number of communication includes all agent requests, responses, and inform messages

E_LEARNING__learning_present.evidence_quote: learning algorithms may be used to incorporate historical information into the agent knowledge and risk assessment.

E_LEARNING__learning_type.evidence_quote: learning algorithms may be used to incorporate historical information into the agent knowledge and risk assessment.

E_LEARNING__explores_beyond_predefined_e.evidence_quote: several aspects of the Knowledge Base are initialized before the manufacturing system begins operating.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: A simulation-based case study is implemented to demonstrate dynamic rescheduling

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__baseline_compared_.evidence_quote: The centralized method re-optimizes the whole system to generate a new schedule with a shorter cycle time than the distributed method.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: If a machine undergoes a breakdown, a rescheduling process will be triggered.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: 20 machines that are connected via a network of 6 mobile robots

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: a modified version of the Intel Mini-Fab [45], a semiconductor manufacturing facility.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: RAj can also request the capability information from the RAs within the manufacturing system to form the clusters dynamically.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Focuses on resource agent (vs product agent) with BDI knowledge base, dynamic capability clustering, and risk assessment (delay and breakdown probability) in rescheduling decisions.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: a rescheduling strategy that incorporates risk assessment via a clustering agent coordination strategy is also proposed.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Argues decision-making must incorporate uncertainty/risk and RA should understand its objectives and environment.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: the decision-making process must incorporate uncertainty and potential risk factors into the optimization.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: this work builds on the agent model and rescheduling strategy proposed in [13].

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: the disrupted RA needs to dynamically determine the agents it coordinates with (i.e. RA cluster)
